Adventure Time - The Secret of the Namel.name: Adventure Time: The Secret of the Nameless Kingdom
Adventure Time - The Secret of the Namel.summary: What time is it? It’s time to join Finn (the human) and his best bro Jake (the shape shifting dog) on an original heroic adventure through the mysterious Nameless Kingdom. Go on epic quests, solve puzzles and uncover secrets by exploring a new realm created exclusively for the video game.

Green Lantern - Rise of the Manhunters.name: Green Lantern: Rise of the Manhunters
Green Lantern - Rise of the Manhunters.summary: Green Lantern: Rise of the Manhunters is a DS/3DS action video game, the first based on DC Comics' Green Lantern.

Monster Strike.name: Monster Strike
Monster Strike.summary:
Monster Strike is a 3DS iteration of the popular smartphone game from mixi. The game is an RPG with the main gameplay being identical with the smartphone version and the world in 3D.
It features characters and stories introduced in the anime.

My Pet School 3D.name: My Pet School 3D
My Pet School 3D.summary: Enjoy a colorful, three-dimensional world with lots of entertaining tasks and minigames.

Pro Yakyuu Famista Climax.name: Pro Yakyuu Famista Climax
Pro Yakyuu Famista Climax.summary: Bandai Namco's comedic baseball series brings new modes and features along with the return of old favorites, including multiple league representation and several zany mini-games.

Yo-Kai Watch 2 - Psychic Specters.name: Yo-Kai Watch 2: Psychic Specters
Yo-Kai Watch 2 - Psychic Specters.summary: Become inspirited and complete the ultimate Yo-Kai Watch experience. The strange but friendly troublemakers, Yo-kai, are back in a time-traveling adventure, and this time their mysterious world is packed with exclusive quests, wicked Yo-kai to befriend, fully new areas to explore, and a revamped Blasters action co-op mode featuring new bosses.
